notImported.folderOutside: Its folder is outside the plugin
notImported.folderMissing: Its folder isn't in the plugin (or is a link)
notImported.skillName: Its name isn't lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
notImported.skillNameOrListed: Its name isn't lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, or is listed twice
notImported.skillDuplicate: Another skill of the plugin has its name
notImported.skillFilePath: One of its files has a path a skill can't hold
notImported.runnerPath: Its path isn't one a runner writes: its stdio servers run without it
notImported.runnerTooLarge: The plugin is larger than a runner takes ({{max}} files or 11 MiB): this server can't run as a runner tool
notImported.definitionKindNotFolder: Not a folder: no definition of it is read
notImported.definitionsNotFolder: Not a folder: no definition is read
notImported.unstorable: It holds a character Dispand can't store
notImported.yamlInvalid: Its frontmatter isn't valid YAML without aliases
notImported.unknownField: It has a field it doesn't take
notImported.unknownFieldIn: It has a field it doesn't take in {{path}}
notImported.referenceField: Its field “{{field}}”: a reference field, and only it, names the table it references
notImported.choicesField: Its field “{{field}}”: only a single select has choices
notImported.parentNeedsPrimitive: Only a primitive table has a parent
notImported.parentNotReference: Its parent “{{field}}” isn't one of its reference fields
notImported.ownParent: A table can't be its own parent
notImported.parentNotPrimitive: Its parent table “{{table}}” isn't a primitive of the plugin
notImported.notCatalog: “{{tool}}” isn't an entry of Dispand's catalog
notImported.notServer: “{{tool}}” isn't a server of the plugin's mcp.json
notImported.notSkill: “{{skill}}” isn't a skill of the plugin
notImported.consultNotAgent: It consults “{{agent}}”, which isn't an agent of the plugin
notImported.triggerNotAgent: Its agent “{{agent}}” isn't an agent of the plugin
notImported.tableSkipped: Its table “{{table}}” is a definition of the plugin that wasn't read
notImported.tableNotPrimitive: “{{table}}” isn't a primitive: no trigger watches it
notImported.extensionField: It has a field other than description: ignored
notImported.extensionDescription: Not text of at most 1,000 characters: ignored
notImported.notManifestField: Not a field of plugin.json: ignored
notImported.skillsNotFolder: Not a folder: no skill is read
notImported.serverTypeNotStdio: Its type isn't stdio, streamable-http or sse
notImported.serverFieldNamed: It has a field its type doesn't take: {{field}}
notImported.serverField: It has a field its type doesn't take
notImported.serverCommand: Its command isn't one name or one ./ path inside the plugin
notImported.serverArgs: Its arguments aren't a list of strings
notImported.serverEnv: Its environment isn't an object of strings
notImported.serverEnvReserved: Its environment sets PLUGIN_ROOT or PLUGIN_DATA
notImported.serverCwd: Its working directory isn't inside the plugin or its data folder
notImported.serverUrl: Its URL isn't absolute http(s), https unless loopback, without credentials or fragment
notImported.serverHeaders: Its headers aren't valid HTTP headers
notImported.serverUrlSetting: Its URL or headers hold ${…}, which Dispand would read as a setting
notImported.serverName: Its name is empty, longer than 100 characters or unreadable

mcpFile.notFile: Not a regular file: no MCP server is read
mcpFile.tooLarge: Larger than 1 MiB: no MCP server is read
mcpFile.notJson: Not valid JSON: no MCP server is read
mcpFile.notObject: Not a JSON object: no MCP server is read
mcpFile.schema: Its $schema isn't an Agent Plugins version Dispand supports: no MCP server is read
mcpFile.otherVersion: It targets another Agent Plugins version than plugin.json: no MCP server is read
mcpFile.serversNotObject: Its mcpServers isn't an object: no MCP server is read
mcpFile.field: It has a field mcp.json doesn't take: no MCP server is read
